title: Dawn Blitz 2017
description: PACIFIC OCEAN (Oct. 27, 2017) Marines from 1st Marines, 4th Division embark an MV-22 Osprey tiltrotor aircraft assigned to the  "Sea Elks" of Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron (VMM) 166 and depart the flight deck of the Wasp-class amphibious assault ship USS Essex (LHD 2) during Dawn Blitz 2017. Dawn Blitz is a scenario-driven exercise designed to train and integrate Navy and Marine Corps units by providing a robust training environment where forces plan and execute an amphibious assault, engage in live-fire events, and establish expeditionary advanced bases in a land and maritime threat environment to improve naval amphibious core competencies. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Donovan K. Paubo/Released)
